author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: events.json binds req_pulse_i to src_clk with a required 3 ns event; the dst_clk sampler period is 10 ns and the path is an exact input-to-D chain p1_q->p2_q with an observable consumer: CDC-013(c) WARNING Established (required assertion shorter than one sampling interval).

author_reading.rationale: Required boundary event of 3 ns minimum assertion is sampled by a 10 ns two-stage non-resettable synchronizer: assertion shorter than one sampling interval, so delivery is not guaranteed.

labels.rationale: The event contract permits a required 3 ns assertion. It can fall wholly between active edges of the 10 ns sampler and be lost despite a clean two-stage chain.

Per events.json, primary input req_pulse_i (design.sv:5, launched on src_clk) has protocol 'event', delivery 'required', and a minimum assertion duration of 3 ns, which is shorter than one 10.0 ns period of the sampling clock dst_clk at p1_q (design.sv:13), allowing required pulses to be missed between sampling edges (CDC-013 WARNING Established).

settlement.rationale: events.json binds req_pulse_i to src_clk with a required 3 ns event; the dst_clk sampler period is 10 ns and the path is an exact input-to-D chain p1_q->p2_q with an observable consumer: CDC-013(c) WARNING Established (required assertion shorter than one sampling interval).
